worked_example_audit.independent_result: Stressed backlogs 2,5,4,0; four exact missed IDs B05/C01/C02/C03; ten timely and fourteen eventually complete. The deadline-3 cut proves four misses necessary and the displayed schedule attains it. Four shifted slots are necessary and sufficient in this case; late authority cannot provide them retrospectively. The 40-CU late amount is not automatically an expense.

The first thirteen distinct valid obligations discharge 130 despite fourteen debits of 140. B02 duplicate consumes 10 equity under the explicit no-recovery assumption; C03 remains a liability. Closing 60=10+50. Ten timely, three late, one missing give four deadline failures. Every observed debit is preserved, including exceptions.

Latent-state enumeration gives marginals 29/200 and 6/25, joint 69/1000, product 87/2500, conditional escape 421/5000, per-request escape 421/250000, expected escapes 421/250 and expected loss 421/10. Full coverage leaves 69/2. Exact common-cause ceiling at full coverage is 1/49; coverage cannot remove the stated common branch.

The fit coefficient 42/21=2 and zero residuals say nothing about an omitted downstream constraint. Staff-only 2,2,8,6 versus constrained 2,2,4,6 changes predicted timely count from fourteen to ten. Resource repair, software mapping repair and observed identity-safe retest are separate interventions.

proof_audit.reason: Compare any feasible schedule with EDF at the earliest differing service slot. Its selected available job a must appear later by its deadline; move it forward or exchange it with the current available b. Because d_b>=d_a and b was already available, both releases/deadlines remain feasible. An idle slot permits a simple move. Finite repeated exchanges align the schedule. Equal single-slot work, simultaneous release before a window and absence of routing/precedence restrictions are essential. The theorem concerns all-on-time feasibility, not best timely count on infeasible inputs. A separate peer three-job case has EDF one timely while an alternative attains two, confirming that explicit limit.

Released inventory minus unique completions equals unfinished work at each cutoff. Any timely job due by cutoff 3 consumes an earlier or current slot, so twelve due against eight slots yields a lower bound of four misses independently of the chosen priority. The repaired release-respecting schedule demonstrates sufficiency only for Cedar. A release-2 job cannot consume a sole date-1 slot; total capacity alone is insufficient.

Each actual debit reduces cash. Only the first matching properly authorized row for an obligation reduces its liability; every other debit reduces equity under the stipulated bank-borne irrecoverable-loss convention. The per-row vectors preserve C-L-E=0, so final M-debit/U-discharge balance is rigorous without inferring identities from totals. Premature debit does not discharge a future authorization or block a later valid one. Actual rights, finality, recovery and loss allocation are explicitly not generalized.

Conditioning on common failure yields marginal and joint misses; conditional independence is used only outside that branch. Independent coverage gives the mixture. Expansion verifies nonnegative covariance c(1-c)(1-q1)(1-q2). Linearity of expectation across requests does not require their independence, but no tail distribution follows. Risk-selected bypass, adaptive behavior and changing severity require a different conditional experiment.

The three affine forms 72.5-38f, 10+490c and 50-40f give the exact compact-domain minima/boundaries. Equality at c=1/49 or f=.75 passes; representable values just above/below fail. The redesign comparison is 42.1-10-12=20.1 on the same stated horizon. Changing an input is not proof of attained effectiveness.

Expanding the squared-error objective yields positive quadratic coefficient sum x^2, so its stationary solution is the unique global minimum. The implementation floors the nonnegative predicted count and takes the declared gateway minimum. The deterministic rule does not identify causal productivity or predictive coverage; zero error at the same staffing level can coexist with deployment error.

exact_prompt_solution_audit.independent_resolution: The queue inventories are 2, 5, 4, 0. B05, C01, C02 and C03 miss. By cutoff 3 twelve obligations are due against eight available slots, so any policy misses at least four; the exhibited EDF plan attains this bound. Moving four slots gives (2,2,8,2), serving A in the first two windows, all B/C in window 3 and D in window 4. Fewer than four moved slots cannot repair the cut. Zero final backlog does not erase timing.

Delete only the duplicate: 130 debited and discharged, zero exception loss, closing cash/liability/equity 70/10/60, ten timely, three late and C03 missing. Replace the duplicate with C03 at cutoff 4: 140 debited/discharged, zero exception loss, closing 60/0/60, ten timely and four late, no missing ID. Both remove the stipulated duplicate loss; only replacement discharges C03, and it remains historically late. Both are distinct counterfactual logs, not evidence-editing instructions.

Partition on common failure and independent coverage. Joint miss c+(1-c)q1q2 is .069; marginals .145 and .24 have product .0348, gap .0342. Expansion gives c(1-c)(1-q1)(1-q2). The covered/uncovered mixture is .0842; request probability .001684 and 1000-request fixed-severity expected loss 42.1. If high-risk urgent or suspicious requests bypass the second check, its coverage is no longer independent of the stated failure populations; additional conditional laws are required.

With c=.05, loss equals 72.5-38f, whose minimum on [0,1] is 34.5, above 20. With f=1 it is 10+490c, so c<=1/49. With c=0 it is 50-40f, so f>=3/4. Redesign from baseline to c=0, f=1 gives expected loss 10 and net benefit 42.1-10-12=20.1 CU over the same population/horizon. Algebra cannot establish that the architecture actually attains the new probabilities, severity or independence; tail and deadline tests remain separate.

Positive design curvature 21 and cross product 42 give unique rate 2 and residuals (0,0,0). Staff capacities (2,2,8,6) predict fourteen timely; the gateway minimum (2,2,4,6) permits ten timely and four late. Correcting the deployed rule supplies no physical slot. Hold or restrict an unreviewed version until appropriate independent review binds the artifact, inputs and intended use; one equal output or version label is not that evidence.

After external E01/E02 settlements the actual balance is cash 20, liabilities 10, equity 10. Blind replay of E02/E03 uses 20 cash, discharges only 10 and recognizes duplicate loss 10: final 0/0/0. Confirmed-unpaid E03 alone gives 10/0/10. Preserve restored records and external references, reconcile identities/mandates, hold uncertain items and test retry protection in an authorized isolated environment before release. Restored state does not refute subsequent external events.

Confirmation after cutoff 3 does not add usable earlier capacity: twelve due jobs and eight slots imply at least four misses. A timely effective (2,2,8,2) reservation instead permits zero. A defensible record identifies entity, instructions/mandate/provider terms, required authority, evidence and effective date, owner and last useful cutoff, interim permitted scope and escalation. The later contract/test only changes future capability; no national-law determination or retrospective erasure is justified.

Correct every claimed shortcut: perfect fit omitted the gateway; fourteen debits totaling 140 include duplicate B02 and omit C03; actual unpaid liability 10 and exception loss 10 remain. Two names do not show authority separation; a booted backup does not show integrity or settlement reconciliation. Joint miss .069, not .0348, and baseline expected loss 42.1 exceeds 20; even full coverage leaves 34.5. The dated SR26-2 guidance superseded SR11-7 and does not prescribe an enforceable rule for every calculator. Assign operations, treasury, technology, legal/compliance and independent risk concrete ID, cash, capacity, artifact, retry and authority evidence; preserve original timestamps and separate retests. The five two-point rubric domains total ten and reward defensible evidence-based alternatives, not a predetermined generic checklist. Intrawindow timing, rare-event effectiveness and unresolved rights are valid residual limits.

implementation_audit.portability: Normal and optimized isolated interpreter executions from an unrelated directory test default sibling input, explicit paths and quiet API import/run. Direct, symbolic and hard-link aliases of both input and implementation reject before writing. Duplicate keys, nonfinite JSON, invalid domain and oversize CLI inputs preserve an existing output.

limitations: Machine-assisted separate peer review, not independent human certification, actual control effectiveness or a real incident decision.
All operating data, probabilities, loss severities, thresholds and evidence declarations are original synthetic inputs; neither request-tail probabilities nor empirical calibration is established.

Window-level equal one-slot jobs omit intrawindow phases, routing/precedence, variable durations, inaccessible funds and adaptive behavior. EDF maximum-timely-count optimality on infeasible schedules is deliberately not asserted.

Duplicate/unknown/premature debits are irrecoverable bank-borne losses only by explicit case convention. Real rights, accounting, recoveries, mandates and settlements require their own facts and qualified review.
All-green declarations produce eligibility for independent closure review, not authenticated documents, artifact identity, staff independence or legal permission.
